scope: Read-only exact mapping, first-moment theorem, bounded optimizer protocol, seven tiny controls and fake-solver counterexample; no data fits, likelihood campaign or simulations.

mathematical_review.exact_identity: With rho=0, zero initial modes, b=1, g_phys=eta exp(gamma(Q-1)), kappa_phys=n(1-r)exp(beta r Q), physical intensity is exp(a-eta G)+nH for the shared finite kernel.
mathematical_review.finite_kernel: 195 positive rates and positive normalized weights; h=-Phi prime. No infinite-mode limit is invoked.
mathematical_review.state_and_link: Z<=0, U>=0, Psi(X)=exp(a+X) is positive, nondecreasing, bounded and Lipschitz by exp(a) on X<=0. Initialization is admissible, not stationary.
mathematical_review.first_moments: For eta>0, E[g]=eta exp(-gamma) beta/(beta-gamma) requires beta>gamma. For eta=0, g is identically zero regardless of unscaled stress moment. E[kappa]=n with r=.7<1 and n<=.98.
mathematical_review.higher_moments: For positive eta,n, E[g squared] requires beta>2 gamma, E[kappa squared] requires r<.5, and E[g kappa] requires beta(1-r)>gamma. All three fail at beta=2.8494,r=.7 while first moments exist. The invoked theorem explicitly needs no second moments and allows correlated transforms of the same fresh mark.
mathematical_review.units: Time in days, stress in dimensionless log-intensity units, rates/intensity inverse days, rho stress/day and kappa dimensionless.
mathematical_review.no_extra_guarantees: No physical loading identification, stationary initialization, useful finite-sample mixing rate, Fisher/Wilks theorem, or exact-memory invariant-law assertion is licensed.

numerical_protocol_review.training_only: Beta from each training prefix only; no held-out choice. PredictiveHistory truncates parents at window end and retains every earlier parent. Test events update state only after occurrence.
numerical_protocol_review.nesting: The null a,n fit with d=eta=0 is included as the exact inhibited floor. Both arms use the same integration route at eta=0.
numerical_protocol_review.optimizer: Four deterministic null starts plus analytic Poisson floor; eight inhibited eta starts plus exact fitted null floor. Fixed L-BFGS-B and failure-only same-start recovery. Required-start failure remains unresolved.
numerical_protocol_review.controls: All finite feasible returned vectors and floors receive order16/32 training checks; selected fine-grid gap <=1e-4. Held-out two-arm scores and paired gain must agree at absolute1e-4; final event-free tail and common mark score retained.
numerical_protocol_review.interpretation: New fixed three-fold exploratory reused-data comparison; no significance claim or magnitude-forecast comparison.

tests.scope: Seven model/gradient/moment controls and five fake optimizer-return controls only

findings.finding: solve_slot omits the solver-reported objective, writes pars=None for infeasible returned vectors, and can lose all returned optimizer metadata if the fresh-objective call raises before row.update. This prevents reconstruction of its declared fresh-versus-reported acceptance gate and contradicts all-return retention.
findings.required_fix: Checkpoint raw x, reported fun, status/message/counters immediately after return, using explicit JSON-safe nonfinite representation, before fresh/control evaluation. Preserve that record on subsequent exceptions and add bounded fake-solver tests.
findings.resolution: Immediately checkpointed raw x/fun/status/message/counters now survive nonfinite/infeasible returns and fresh-evaluation exceptions. Explicit JSON nonfinite tags preserve strict JSON. Fresh objective, discrepancy, 1e-7 gate and 1e-8 nonworsening gate are recorded. Original fake counterexample now passes; five new controls verify edge cases.

prospective_bounds_after_fix.production_condition: Only after amended source review and passed fixed pilot with resource gates; only if original oracle/S04B numerical work is finished and sufficient shared run budget remains. Positive/negative gain does not decide admission.

pilot_admission.priority: Do not run concurrently with or delay admitted oracle/S04B numerical work.
pilot_admission.required_pre_execution: Root verifies the pinned source/protocol/data hash and available run time; actual training beta>gamma gate remains unevaluated until the fixed pilot.
pilot_admission.failure_policy: Preserve any ineligible mark law, failed start, negative gain, numerical discrepancy or timeout. No outcome-dependent law/solver/bound/start/tolerance change.

full_run_admission.gate: A passed fixed pilot and observed resource cost may admit the original full three-fold roster only when sufficient global budget remains. Do not select continuation based on gain sign; pool only after all folds complete.

review_type: Internal source/protocol review by a separate computational agent; no external peer review or empirical execution.
